name: acne-v6-pilot-20261016

config.trainable: YOLOX head + PAFPN neck convs; BatchNorm frozen (eval); backbone frozen

unchanged: v4/v5 architecture and loss: budgeted objectness (K=64 hard + 192 random, lambda 36.57), lr 5e-5, warmup 50, clip 2000, accum 8, 40% negative-photo tiles, head+neck trainable, BN frozen; start Step0 18e94a95 + new optimizer; product conf .30 / NMS .30 unchanged
changed: data coverage and selection control only: v5 core (65 photos) + 83 reviewed TRAIN-extension photos (278 kept of 1,229 source acne boxes; 951 ignored with reason; 34 of 120 confounders kept as explicit negatives; 47 accepted clean ROIs on 35 photos) = 148 positive photos, 514 kept boxes, clean ROIs on 76 photos (1,656,838 px) + the same 41 auxiliary TRAIN negatives

gateEvaluation.evaluator: eval_acne_v6.py combined (label-independent product preprocessing; eyewear UNKNOWN)
gateEvaluation.set: v4 DEV 17 replay-pass positive photos + 11 replay-pass VALIDATION DEV-EXT photos = 28 photos / 201 source targets (63 small, 138 medium); 14 Clear negatives; frozen reviewed clean ROIs on 13 positive DEV photos (226,001 px; decisions 3987e8e5.. and b58481e0..)

passIf: G2 small: small hit50 >= 14 (no loss vs Step0)
G3 Clear negatives: FP in mask <= 1
G4 positive-DEV clean ROI: false candidates <= 1
G5 false-candidate growth: unlabeled candidates (final candidates not matched at IoU .30) <= 420 (1.5 x Step0 280)
G6 no score collapse: final candidates >= 76 (0.25 x Step0)
G7 box placement: median matched area ratio in [0.75, 1.29] (Step0 1.142 + 0.15)
G8 optimisation: all losses finite and <= 20% clipped steps in the last 50
rule: ALL of G1..G8 must hold; otherwise no main run. Thresholds fixed before the pilot is run and never changed afterwards.
g5Rationale: V5 step-150 passed its own gate but failed the product chain (reviewed-negative false candidates 3 -> 14). On this DEV set its clean-ROI false candidates were only 0 -> 1 (the ROI area is small), while unlabeled candidates grew 280 -> 588 (2.1x). G5 is therefore a conservative proxy: unlabeled candidates include some real unlabeled lesions, so it can reject a genuinely better model; it is used only as a selection control, never as a success claim.
productAcceptanceUnchanged: unchanged v2 product chain; success iff hit50 over 138 targets >= 62 (Step0 59 + 3), reviewed-negative false candidates <= 7, lost <= gained / 3
sealed: Skin care v5 closed; production accepted:false
